text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens, in good health. Comply with Chinese laws and regulations, respect Chinese customs and traditions. For those who were Chinese citizens originally and later acquired foreign nationality, follow the relevant regulations of the Ministry of Education; 2. Applicants for a bachelor's degree must have a high school diploma or equivalent educational qualification, and be between 18 and 30 years old.
